name: Stay With... ~Karen ga Kureta Kisetsu~
original_name: Stay With… ～カレンがくれた季節～
source:
Kazuya steals an android girl that was going to be disposed of. In a couple days the android suddenly starts to move and talk, so they start living together. However, android Karen's secret is concealed in the depths of a mysterious organization. 

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
